title: 1.7 Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides

icans: I can solve equations with variables on both sides.
I can identify equations that have no solution or infinitely many solutions.
I can write and solve these equations for real-life problems.

vocab: move the variable __________ to one side first
an ___________ true for every value of the variable (infinitely many solutions)
the equation _____________ to a false statement, such as 3 = 7

blocks.p: Gym A: $30 a month plus $5 per visit.     Gym B: $10 per visit.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Variables on both sides: Collect the variable terms on _______________ side.
Identity: Variables cancel and a true statement is left: _______________.
No solution: Variables cancel and a false statement is left: _______________.

blocks.stem: Taxi A charges $3 plus $2 per mile. Taxi B charges $5 plus $1.50 per mile. For how many miles do they cost the same?
